## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `make validate` or explained why it could not run.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I updated public docs and `CHANGELOG.md` when behavior changed.
- [ ] I reviewed privacy, XDG storage, and network effects.
- [ ] I did not add direct `pacman -Syu` advice, curl-to-shell, telemetry, or security assurances.
- [ ] I did not include tokens, inventories, caches, local state, or generated artifacts.
